items.requirement: Classify reusable surfaces into pages, panels, record cards, tables, editors, dialogs and contextual overlays.
Establish representative fixtures containing long names, missing values, large counts, mixed statuses and boundary dates.
Identify protected workflow invariants, including selected-month continuity, assignment preservation, reviewed imports and explicit publishing.
Define objective pass conditions and supporting evidence for every numbered upgrade before marking it complete.
Establish a clear typography scale for page titles, panel headings, field labels, body text and metadata.
Define consistent spacing tokens for page gutters, card padding, field groups, toolbars and stacked mobile actions.
Establish distinct radius tokens for fields, cards, dialogs and status chips instead of indiscriminate pill shapes.
Classify each existing table as a comparison grid or record list before choosing its mobile representation.
Provide accessible nonvirtualized summaries or navigation where virtualization would otherwise hide content from assistive technology.
Make member identity, designation, effective call level and active status clear before secondary history or administrative metadata.
Preserve desktop rails and mobile tabs, automatically revealing the active tab without stealing focus and providing discoverable scroll cues.
Standardize tab labels, counts and ordering across overview, postings, leave, duties, history and administrative sections.
Preserve tablist/tab/tabpanel relationships, roving focus and orientation-aware navigation while keeping ordinary page navigation available.
Keep the identity header compact while allowing full names and designations to wrap without overlapping close controls.
Surface unsaved changes and validation errors on their relevant tabs so hidden form problems remain discoverable.
Present dated promotions and call-level changes as a readable timeline with clear scheduled-versus-effective distinctions.
Reflow posting and leave histories into date-aware mobile cards while keeping edit actions adjacent to the affected record.
Separate member-facing information from administrator metadata through hierarchy and progressive disclosure rather than hidden essential context.
Keep workload summaries compact and readable, linking to actual duties using existing supported detail or report views.
Show missing designation, unknown history and unassigned values honestly instead of presenting misleading zeroes or placeholder identities.
Present full date ranges for cross-month leave so monthly approval cannot appear narrower than its actual effect.
Give calendars keyboard behavior matching their actual semantics; never add grid roles without the complete interaction pattern.
Reflow leave-pressure summaries into readable unit and call-level groups without duplicating every explanatory paragraph.
Inspect HTML revalidation, immutable hashed assets and previous-release retention as hosting dependencies without silently modifying server infrastructure.
Prepare a concrete review build, rollback instructions and an unresolved-issue list before requesting any separate deployment approval.
